+import csv
+from io import StringIO
+
+
+def read_records(text: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Parse CSV records, normalizing whitespace and validating row widths."""
+    if not text.strip():
+        return []
+
+    rows = csv.reader(StringIO(text, newline=""))
+    headers = [cell.strip() for cell in next(rows)]
+    if not headers or any(not header for header in headers):
+        raise ValueError("CSV headers must not be empty")
+    if len(set(headers)) != len(headers):
+        raise ValueError("CSV headers must be unique")
+
+    records = []
+    for row in rows:
+        if len(row) != len(headers):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"CSV row ending on line {rows.line_num} has {len(row)} cells; "
+                f"expected {len(headers)}"
+            )
+        records.append(dict(zip(headers, (cell.strip() for cell in row))))
+    return records
